# Viking lander range data
#
# These represent a round-trip light time for each range measurement
# by the NASA Deep Space Network to Viking Lander 1 and Viking Lander 2.
#
# Range measurements were made at S-band (signal from Earth-to-lander at ~2.1 GHz
# and signal from lander-to-Earth at ~2.3GHz). During the first few years of the
# lander data set, range measurements to Viking Orbiters were also made,
# with a dual-frequency downlink (~2.3 GHz and ~8.4GHz from spacecraft-to-Earth).
# This dual-frequency measurement was used to correct the solar plasam effect on
# the Viking Lander range data. After dual-frequency range data from the orbiters
# was no longer available, it appears some model solar plasma delay correction
# was applied to the lander range data. The details of the plasma calibration
# are no longer available.
#
# In addition to the solar plasma calibration, a model Earth
# troposphere has been removed, so no troposphere model
# should be used in the solution software.
#
# The table columns are;
#   Column 1 is a spacecraft identifier (1 for VL1, 2 for VL2, 3 for MPF, 4 for MGS, 5 for ODY, 6 for MRO)
#   Column 2 is the DSN transmitting station ID
#   Column 3 is the DSN receiving station ID
#   Column 4-6 are the UTC date at station reception
#   Column 7 is the UTC time at station reception
#   Column 8 is the adjusted round-trip light time in microseconds
#               from the DSN station to the lander and back
#   Column 9 is the estimated measurement accuracy in microseconds
#
